description: A gruvbox theme for coding: 0px corners, flat surfaces, a JetBrains Mono interface and a composer styled as a terminal prompt, so bb reads like a terminal. Dark mode is gruvbox soft (#32302f); light mode keeps gruvbox's ink on a neutral paper base instead of the yellow #fbf1c7, with accents darkened to stay readable. Ships gruvbox syntax colours for diffs and a gruvbox terminal palette for each mode. Pick Gruve under Settings → Appearance.
